decisions.reason: Uses LinkType=Junction/Target and the link marker to show the profile entry resolves to the repo; explicitly states edits are already live, the copy is a self-copy on the same file objects, and distinguishes copied installs.

Attributes both EBUSY locks to the running host, shows tab closure released nothing, separately explains browser HTTP/ES-module caching, and requires host restart plus cache-bypassing refresh; warns against inferring the browser holds handles.

Explains renames went through the junction onto the sole source files, making the later source copy fail; restores both .old2 names preserving contents, verifies with node --check, then activates; stopping the host first is offered as precaution, no recreation required.

§4 gives the semantic order: full host stop (port verified free), restart dsh web, verify served bytes, hard refresh with cache bypass, then positive verification of the feature and no load errors; syntax check is separated from activation.

§5 puts LinkType/Target and the cordis.patch.yml link marker before any file operation, gives a linked-vs-copied decision table, and explains the generic copy-into-node_modules advice presupposed a false topology and degraded into a destructive self-copy.

caps.reason: Final plan explicitly forbids copying into node_modules and restores by rename only; self-copy appears only as rejected diagnosis.
Plan requires full host stop/restart before refresh; tab-refresh-only is cited only as the mistake that caused the incident.
